The task is complete. I implemented the three missing operations in `Spans.calr`, following the conventions already present in `TotalCovered` (while-loop iteration, `§IDX`/`§LEN` primitives, effect-free `§E{}`, and contract annotations):

1. **`ContainsPoint(starts, ends, x)` → `bool`** — scans intervals, returning `true` when `starts[i] <= x < ends[i]` (respecting the half-open ranges), else `false`.

2. **`ClipCovered(starts, ends, lo, hi)` → `i32`** — for each interval, clamps to `[max(starts[i], lo), min(ends[i], hi))` and adds the positive width; precondition `lo <= hi` and postcondition `result >= 0` declared.

3. **`GapCount(starts, ends)` → `i32`** — counts consecutive pairs where `starts[i+1] - ends[i] > 0` (touching intervals excluded); `0` for zero/one interval.

Each carries the `§Q (== §LEN starts §LEN ends)` length precondition, and the count/clip functions declare `§S (>= result 0)`. `TotalCovered` was left unchanged. The build succeeds with 0 warnings and 0 errors, and all Calor checks (compile, contracts, effects, references) pass.
